advanced-filter-description: Sefe se se tseneletseng se go letla go kwala mokwalo o o nang le diopereitara tse: == != <= >= && || ( ) Sekgala se kgaoganya diopereitara. O ka sefa mabala otlhe a a rulagantsweng ka maina le boleng jwa one. Sekai: Field1 == Value1. Fa mabala kgotsa boleng di na le dikgala, di tsenye mo matshwaong a nopolo a le mangwe. Sekai: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Dirisa backslash go tlola tlhaka e e laolang. Sekai: Field1 == I'm. O ka kopanya maemo a mantsi. Sekai: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Diopereitara di tlhalosiwa go tswa molemeng go ya mojeng; fetola thulaganyo ka masakana. Sekai: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). O ka batla mabala a mokwalo ka regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i

email-recovery-description: Mola o le mongwe wa moamogedi mongwe le mongwe. Batla ka ID ya modirisi. Diteng tsa molaetsa le dikarolo tsa imeile tsa moamogedi ga di bontshiwe. Go ema nakwana go tshwara melaetsa e e leng teng le e e tlang; Go tswelela go leka gape go romela melaetsa e e mo moleng gone jaanong. Go khansela go tlosa melaetsa e e tsentsweng mo moleng go fitlha ka nako ya kopo. Fa go romela go tshwaregile, leka gape morago ga nakwana. Molaetsa o o setseng o simolotse go romelwa ga o ka ke wa busediwa morago, mme go romela mo go nang le dipholo tse di sa tlhomamang go ka boelediwa. Go palelwa ga leruri le melaetsa e e fitlheletseng tekanyetso ya maiteko di sala gore di sekasekiwe. Go leka gape melaetsa e e paletsweng go simolola modikologo o mosha wa maiteko mme go boloka go ema nakwana mo go setseng go le teng.
email-recovery-empty: Ga go melaetsa mo moleng e bile ga go baamogedi ba go romela go emisitsweng nakwana mo go bone.
email-recovery-failed: Tiro ga e a kgona go netefadiwa. Ntšhafatsa mola mme o leke tiro e e tshwanang gape fa go tlhokega.

r-workflow-help: Goga e sekgotlho le e tiro into builder, morago foo tsenya molao. Goga e tiro onto e existing molao go fetola eng sona e dira.
r-wrike-workflow-note: Phatlalo ya tiro ya Wrike ke lenaane la maemo, lengwe le lengwe le le mo setlhopheng sa Active, Completed, Deferred kgotsa Cancelled. Go ntsha go kwala manaane a boto e jaaka phatlalo e le nngwe, e e bidiwang ka leina la boto, mo JSON e API ya Wrike e e busetsang mo diphatlalong tsa tiro: dira phatlalo eo mo Wrike pele o tsenya go ntsha ga Excel ga Wrike ga boto, gore maemo a yona a dirisiwe. Go tsenya go bala JSON eo e e kgomareditsweng kwa godimo, go tswa mo WeKan kgotsa mo GET /workflows ya Wrike, mo botong e e tlhophilweng: boemo jo bo se nang lenaane bo nna lenaane, mme molao o tshwaya karata e weditswe fa e sutisediwa mo boemong jwa Completed kgotsa Cancelled mme ga e a wediwa mo go Active kgotsa Deferred. Melao ya Wrike ka boyona ya tiriso ya boitiriso ga e kgone go ntshiwa mo Wrike.
